environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with ALB forwarding all traffic directly. The task role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/upload-service-task-role) has broad S3 and EC2 permissions. The upload directory /var/www/uploads is served directly by Gin's Static handler with no content-type restrictions. No WAF is attached to the ALB. The container runs as root with default seccomp profile. The EFS mount backing /var/www/uploads has no additional access controls.

config.network: Public subnet, ALB with no WAF
config.storage: EFS mount at /var/www/uploads, served via Gin Static handler
